about: Open the throttle, pass your opponents and cross the finish line. Live the dream of being the next champion with the new MotoGP™23, more amazing and challenging than ever!

Choose from the four acclaimed championship classes MotoGP™, Moto2™, Moto3™ and MotoE™, step into the shoes of your favourite rider and head to the track to experience the adrenaline of the 2023 season.
Embark on your path to set the record: make your debut in Moto3™ and depending on your results, climb the rankings and go up a class.
In the motorsport world, every decision counts! Influence the trend of a season by planning your career in a way that best suits you.

Develop your bike to get increasingly improved performance and also keep the most experienced opponents at bay, win your position on the official team by beating the leading rider, or change teams to prove that what makes the difference is not the…
summary: The official game of the MotoGP™ is back with tons of new developments.
